description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'TracingHelper' that provides methods for working with OpenTracing API, including injecting and extracting span contexts into/from JSON objects, messages, headers, and creating child/spans for tracing purposes.

classes.name: TracingHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for tracing operations via OpenTracing API, including context injection/extraction, span creation, and error logging.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Marks an OpenTracing span as erroneous and logs an exception or message; does not finish the span.

methods.name: getErrorLogItems
methods.description: Creates a map of log items for an error, including error event and object.

methods.name: injectSpanContext
methods.description: Injects a SpanContext into various formats: JSON object, AMQP message, vert.x DeliveryOptions, or headers map.

methods.name: extractSpanContext
methods.description: Extracts a SpanContext from various formats: JSON object, AMQP message, or headers.

methods.name: buildChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a child-of reference to a given span context.

methods.name: buildFollowsFromSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a follows-from reference to a given span context.

methods.name: buildSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a specified reference type and optional sampling priority from context.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets 'sampling.priority' tag and baggage item on a span.

methods.name: adoptSamplingPriorityFromContext
methods.description: Reads 'sampling.priority' from span context baggage items and sets corresponding tags in span builder.
